criteria.rationale: R3/D1: verifyActionClaimWithin uses supplied write time and bounded recorded precision on read; live pins/grants and editable acceptance timestamps do not prove immutable historical authorization. Historical expiry/precision regression passes.

R4: declared no-proof history remains declared; valid proof derives verified even after label downgrade; recorded SSH verifies after key rotation. CLI/MCP first exercise declared success before intentional proofless-verified refusal. No schema migration.

R1/R5: LoadActionRequest verifies before deriveActionView and appendActionEvent checks prior history before idempotency. A renderer-only check leaves JSON/MCP/list/gates bypassable. D1 reuses explicit-time issuer verification for R3.

Spec, decision log and changelog preserve R1-R5/D1 and trust limits. Current roadmap statements were corrected after #178. This review distinguishes technical approval from maintainer acceptance; B01 stays partial and B02 waits. See independent review section of qualification report.

R5 domain and real CLI/MCP transport tests assert action-claim-not-verified for show/list/presentation and incomplete unavailable Attention/obligations. Reader returns an error without rewriting evidence; no silent omission of corrupt actions.

Reviewed attributed bundle path segments, not the contaminated base..head range. Original #157 implements R1-R5 in three domain files; #179 adds two transport tests and qualification. No runtime or requirement/baseline/policy change by this review; B04 remains terminal.

R2: SSH binds statement/key/namespace/fingerprint/presence flags; issuer verifies Ed25519, pins, audience/project, request, actor, answer/reason and times. Mixed proofs must both validate. Tamper subtests and CLI/MCP deny the cheap verified-label-only bypass. Synthetic credentials only.

Shared-reader verification is the smallest sufficient R1/R5 fix; renderer-only checking is insufficient. Reuse verifier/time parameter for R3 and preserve R4 legacy. No cache/daemon/new policy or migration. Historical authorization receipts or measured load needs would require a separate scoped decision.
